import re, glob
for f in sorted(glob.glob('svc/m*.py')):
    s = open(f).read()
    n = s.replace('legacy_fetch(', 'fetch_v2(')
    n = re.sub(r'^(from svc\.api import .*)\blegacy_fetch\b', r'\1fetch_v2', n, flags=re.M)
    if n != s: open(f,'w').write(n)
a = open('svc/api.py').read()
a2 = re.sub(r'def legacy_fetch\(.*?\n\n\n', '', a, flags=re.S)
open('svc/api.py','w').write(a2)
print(a2)
